title: Exact zeros then stand noise at a given rate: the first chunk's template is judged as every reading is, so the lead is left out (#2189)
origin: **How:** Introduced by #842. The sound veto came in with #678 (merged 2026-10-30); #842 (merged 2026-11-01) then judged the template on timing alone, so the rule existed and the new code missed it. `stream::first_beats_in` keeps the first chunk's beat template once its beats look like a watch's (#476), and judged that on timing scatter alone (under 2% of a beat). On this recording at 28,800 the stand noise from 10 s scatters 1.9% of a beat (median of six 10 s windows: 3.2, 2.0, 1.8, 3.6, 2.3, 2.5 ms against a 2.5 ms line). So the noise's template was kept, the watch was read with it, the watch's chunk never counted as "first heard" and no step onto the watch was found. With the zeros cut the windows fall on another grid and the same noise reads 2.9%, so it fails the test, which is why only this recording showed it. Every reading's verdict (`measure::no_watch_reason`) already lets the beats' averaged sound veto a scatter in the doubt zone (0.6% to 2%, #675, #1965); the template's test never had that veto. Now it calls the same function: a new private `stream::watch_heard_in` takes the beats' windows through the same two helpers the take's beat sound sample uses (`stream::beat_window`, the short-template `profile::snippet`; `stream::sound_snippet`, good beats only, Tick from the even beats; both new, so the choice is made once) and asks `measure::beat_sound_found` only where `measure::beat_sound_needed` says the scatter is in doubt. The noise's sound shows no unlock or drop on either side, so it gives no template. `first_beats_in` now takes the `AnalysisConfig` (it needs the amplitude config) instead of the window length; its two callers pass the one they hold.

title: Empty stand: no waiting reading counts as heard, whole readings leave the stand's lead out, an arriving watch stays found (#1965, #2177, #2178)
origin:
- **#1965 (strip at Average Over 2 s and 4 s).** Opened, `ym42_DU_65h_excerpt_emptystand` drew its noise on the strip as Tick and Tock lines at 2 s and 4 s, while the cards said No Regular Beat. A reading under 10 s of sound waits for its verdict (`measure::awaiting_verdict`, #2014): it has no figures and `watch_heard` stays true. `TrendReading::of` counted that as heard. At 2 s and 4 s the readings from 1 s to 8 s are whole, so 15 points of the charts' run (12 at 4 s) said a watch was heard, and the app's `no_watch_yet` (any heard point in the run) stopped calling the take noise. At 10 s and over, those readings are not whole, which is why 10 s was right. Run with `LiveAnalyzer::from_log` on the take, Auto and at its 28,800 bph: 15 heard points at 2 s, 12 at 4 s, 0 at 10 s. **Latent:** waiting readings counted as heard since short averages existed; #2144, the fix this reopening follows, tested from 10 s on and missed the first seconds.
- **#2177 (whole take +452.9 s/d).** `session::measure_together`, which reads the app's whole take and each Positions Test row, read a stretch from its start, noise and all. `analyze` and a take's entries (`take::open_entry`) leave a lead of noise before the watch out (`session::lead_s`, #844); this reader did not. Reproduced in the app's own test harness (`listened_then`, Quick Listen of 70 s of `silence_empty_stand`, 100 s of `ym42_DU_2h` file 001, 60 s of the stand, Stop): the whole take read **+449.0 s/d**, This Take +52.3, the command line +50.9 with "first 70 s left out". **Introduced by #2164:** a just-stopped take is now read as its saved take opens, from the stream engine's log, which holds the noise's beats; before the Stop read came in, the same harness read +52.3. Underneath it is a **design gap**: the lead rule lived in two callers, not in the one reading of a stretch.
- **#2178 (arriving watch at 1 min).** A regular run heard after noise is "Finding the Beat", no verdict, for `live::FINDING_S` (20 s). That length was set for a 10 s average, whose look back is 15 to 20 s. At 1 min the look back is the whole minute, so for 10 to 15 s after the 20 s ran out it still held the noise: the cards said No Regular Beat and the strip's dots went faint. Pushed live (40 s of `silence_empty_stand`, then `ym42_DU_2h` file 001): finding until 59 s, No Regular Beat from 60 s to 75 s, figures from 76 s. **Design gap** in #2013 (#2008).
- `session::lead_s` reads masked time as masked, not missing (`watch_lead_masked`). In `watch_lead_s`'s pair test, a grid slot whose 10 s window overlaps a mask no longer breaks the pair. A jump inside a mask or at its ends (where the app's reading cuts sit) is left out with the mask. Before, a clean watch's first window, whose pair lay across a mask, read as noise, and the first window past the mask was taken as the watch's start. With `measure_together` now leaving a lead out, a position read in two masked-apart stretches lost its first one (caught by `app::whole_tests::a_mask_between_two_stretches_counts_once_on_the_whole_take` at 138b546). This is **latent** for a take's entries whose first 20 s or so hold a mask. `watch_lead_s` keeps its signature and reads as before with no mask.
